contribute_section.sub_title: Section heading (H2). Title of the contribute section near the bottom of the homepage. Keep short.
contribute_section.msg_1: Section body text. One sentence summarizing contribution options. Shown below the section heading.
contribute_section.link_label: Link label. Links to the contribute section on the about page. Keep concise.

table_score_comparison.tsc_caption: Table caption for the benchmark score comparison table on the homepage.
table_score_comparison.tsc_mean: Table row label. Identifies the arithmetic mean row.
table_score_comparison.tsc_distribution: Table row group label. Groups the percentile rows.
table_score_comparison.tsc_p90: Table row label. 90th percentile. Technical label, keep as 'p90'.
table_score_comparison.tsc_data: Table row group label. Groups the dataset metadata rows.
table_score_comparison.tsc_last_update: Table row label. Shows the date the benchmark data was last updated.
table_score_comparison.tsc_n: Table row label. Shows the number of data points. 'n' is a standard statistical symbol, keep it.

stats_texts.title: Section heading (H2). Title of the global benchmark statistics section on the homepage.
stats_texts.explain_stats_list_1: Statistics explanation text. Markdown-formatted bullet list shown in the benchmark statistics section. Explains the mean and each percentile (p10–p90) with a plain-language interpretation. Contains placeholders for the data point count, last update date, and each percentile value. Preserve all markdown formatting and placeholders.
stats_texts.link_label_to_stats_page: Link label. Links to the full statistics page. Keep concise.

statistical_violin_boxplot.title: SVG/chart title attribute for the violin-boxplot chart on the homepage. Short label.
statistical_violin_boxplot.aria_label: ARIA label for the violin-boxplot chart. Read aloud by screen readers. Describes the chart type and what it shows.
